context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 62 verified and fixed the TCIS color theme. All banned colors (purple, violet, pink, fuchsia, green, emerald, teal, cyan) have been removed from the codebase. The allowed palette is: Navy (#1B2A4A), Blue (#2E6CC4), Gold (#C5A55A), Amber (#F59E0B), Red (#DC2626), and Slate grays. The 'green' color key in StatCard and KpiCard components now maps to gold (#C5A55A) for success states.
